tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma 'od zer can bsgrub par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de yi ched du 'od zer can ma bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas oṃ swa bhā ba'i sngags kyis bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma/ a las zla ba'i steng du/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du padma dang zla ba'i steng du/ bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo bhrūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer phar 'phros sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa dang sems can smin par byas/ slar 'dus nas gcig tu 'dres pa las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i thugs kar rang gi shes pa mam̐ las mya ngan med pa'i shing mam̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las rang nyid 'od zer can ma phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i gser gyi shing rta'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' can shin tu mdzes pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bar bsams pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ bsam/ snying gi nang gi mam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor pa spyan drangs/ oṃ mā rī tsyai argham̐ pra tītstsha swā hā/ la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mā rī tsyai sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas rang la gnyis su med par bstim/

yang 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs/ snga ma bzhin du mchod nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de la sems gtad de mnyam par gzhag go /sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ snying gi nang gi mam̐ gyi mtha' ma sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyud bskul nas rang byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing gzungs nas 'byung ba'i sngags rnams dang*/ oṃ mā rī tsyai mam̐ swā hā/ zhes yang snying ci nus pa bzla'o// grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag bdun cu'o// bzlas pa tshar ba dang rang la bstim pa'i ye shes pa phyung nas mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs te/ mchod pas mchod nas bzod par gsol zhing oṃ badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol te/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyad do// gzungs 'don par 'dod na/ thog mar nyi ma dang zla ba shar ba'i phyogs su phyogs te/ der 'od zer can ma mngon sum ltar dmigs pa la/ mchod nas gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir gzungs bton pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i phyag g.yas pa brkyang ba bdag gi spyi bor bzhag nas/ byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing gzungs 'don no// mthar yang mchod cing bstod nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bsngo// gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas dkar gtor bshams pa a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bskyed nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun du spyan drangs/

de la gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ tadya thā oṃ ba ta li/ ba da li/ ba ra li/ ba ra ha mu khi/ sarba duṣṭān/ pra duṣṭā nām̐/ tsakṣu rmu kham̐/ bandha bandha/ bandha mu kham̐/ dzambha ya/ stambha ya/ mo ha ya/ i dam̐ ba liṃ/ gṛhṇā pa ya/ gṛhṇā pa ya swā hā/ zhes sngags bdun gyis phul nas/ argham̐ la sogs pas mchod la/ gang gis mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// 'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob byed cing*// dri med bde chen nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// phag bdun gyis drangs rin chen shing rta'i khrir// padma zla ba'i gdan la bder bzhugs shing*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser bzang mdog mtshungs pa// bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag g.yas gdul bya rnams la mchog stsol zhing*// g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin la// sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes shing dgyes dgur spyod// bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gis khyod sku dran zhing sngags bzlas te// rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs kyis// bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*// chos bzhin bsam pa 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa rnams kyis bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo// de nas 'dod pa'i don thams cad gnang nas rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam mo// tshul 'di la rtag tu rnal 'byor du byas na/ bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro// 'od zer can ma sgrub pa'i thabs// skad gnyis smra ba du lag gis// gsol ba btab nas 'phags pas sbyar// dge des kun mkhyen thob par shog /lcags mo lug gi lo/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin mo shing kun gyi sa char sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
